call_sites_note: no production module imports scripts.iron_limb_reference; the package is reached only by its own test file and by its SLURM entry points (measure.py, controls.py main).

findings.text: non-blocking: the fragment states 'The 3D reference meets its convergence clause' while the six-limb table beside it shows only the 0.18 to 0.13 m pair; the cited receipt's reference_differences records four steps whose flux changes are 0.43%, 1.41%, 9.00% and 1.05%, so the change does not shrink at every step as plan section 1 clause 1 requires, and a reader of the fragment cannot see the 9% step. The coordinator's resume-2 ruling accepted the reference on the last pair, so the sentence follows a ruling rather than the clause; the intermediate steps should be shown beside it.

non-blocking: the declared negative control (negative-control-neutral.log) flips the charge sign in scripts/prototypes/iron_limb_fill/bricks.py, the independent comparator, so it shows that the dipole assertion fires but records no evidence that a defect in the landed solver reddens a test; the solver-side guard at tests/test_iron_limb_reference.py:38-62 is never exercised by a mutation, so its sensitivity rests on reading rather than measurement.

justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/iron_limb_reference/surface.py:281-329 solves the charge equation and measure.py:351-395 drives the reference to five resolutions whose finest-pair changes are 1.05%/1.21%, so the reference is delivered; the plan's shrink-every-step and 2%-annulus clauses are unmet and carried as stated caveats under a coordinator ruling.
justifications.reuse: scripts/iron_limb_reference/drive.py:6 reuses nova.biot.greens.greens_psi and measure.py:258-263 reuses the prototype axisymmetric Model instead of forking it; a search of nova/biot for a single-layer or solid-angle kernel found no owner (polygonanalytic.py is the axisymmetric full-turn Biot-Savart owner, nova/biot/magnetisation.py:1-5 the axisymmetric volume-cell owner), so the 3D surface method extends rather than duplicates, though it is a second iron-magnetisation solver beside that owner.
